newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CMG SEES "VERY GOOD" FULL-YR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CMG SEES "VERY GOOD" FULL-YR RESULTS.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch computer services firm Computer Management Group (CMG) said on Tuesday it was confident of delivering very good full-year results.
The company quoted its chairman, Cor Stutterheim, as saying the group's performance since the end of June continued to be satisfactory and its main markets remained strong.

"Having delivered good results in the first half of the year, we are confident that the second half, traditionally CMG's stronger half, will enable us to deliver very good results for the full year," Stutterheim said.
"We remain well placed to benefit from the strong growth anticipated for our industry in the years ahead."
